iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Tripartite Shrine / Pagoda.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/wa/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 38 (Tripartite Shrine / Pagoda) depicts Minoan tripartite peak sanctuary or multi-storied shrine. Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_036 and Linear A AB54. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/wa/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 38): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Tripartite Shrine / Pagoda) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/wa/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
